# `jaywalnut310/vits` vendor scaffold (SBV2 v2 Task 30)

**Status: SCAFFOLD ONLY.** This directory currently ships exactly two files
— this `README.md` and `LICENSE` (a byte-identical, unmodified copy of the
upstream MIT license text) — and **zero lines of vendored source code**. No
`.py` module lives here yet. That is deliberate: see "Why deferred" below.

## What this is

[`jaywalnut310/vits`](https://github.com/jaywalnut310/vits) is the original
author reference implementation of VITS (Kim et al. 2021, *Conditional
Variational Autoencoder with Adversarial Learning for End-to-End
Text-to-Speech*, arXiv:2106.06103) — **MIT licensed**. Style-Bert-VITS2's
own upstream architecture is a descendant of this codebase (VITS ->
VITS2 -> Bert-VITS2 -> Style-Bert-VITS2), which is exactly why it is on the
permissive-reference allowlist in
`docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-26-sbv2-v2-design.md` §6 ("参照可能
(permissive のみ)" table) and this project's Task 30 brief (line 11):
Vokra's clean-room SBV2 v2 port may read/derive-from this repository's code,
but must **never** read `litagin02/Style-Bert-VITS2` or
`fishaudio/Bert-VITS2` (both AGPL-3.0) themselves.

- **Source**: <https://github.com/jaywalnut310/vits>
- **License**: MIT, `Copyright (c) 2021 Jaehyeon Kim` (full text in the
  sibling `LICENSE` file, fetched verbatim from
  `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jaywalnut310/vits/main/LICENSE` and
  diffed byte-identical against that URL before being committed here — never
  retyped from memory).
- **Repo metadata verified** (via the public GitHub API, `2026-07-26`):
  default branch `main`, `license.spdx_id = "MIT"`, latest commit on `main`
  at verification time `2e561ba58618d021b5b8323d3765880f7e0ecfdb`
  (`2021-06-14T07:47:15Z`). Pin a specific commit SHA here (rather than a
  moving `main`) once the actual vendoring below happens, so a future
  upstream force-push or edit cannot silently change what Vokra's clean-room
  port was diffed against.

## Why vendored (not `pip install`)

There is no PyPI package published under this name that is this repository
— `pip install vits` does **not** resolve to `jaywalnut310/vits` (per this
task's own ambiguity-resolution notes: "the PyPI package name is NOT `vits`
(that's usually unrelated)"). The only distribution channel is the GitHub
repository itself, so the permissive-license-preserving way to depend on
specific pieces of it is to vendor the minimal needed source with clear
attribution, per `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-26-sbv2-v2-design.md` §6
("tensor name mapping の獲得手順", step 4: "論文 + jaywalnut310/vits (MIT)
と突き合わせ").

## Why deferred (this scaffold, not a full port, lands with Task 30)

Task 30's stated DoD is `tools/parity/sbv2_dump_reference.py --help` exiting
`0` — a CLI-surface + manifest-schema-contract deliverable, not a
fully-working numeric reference forward pass. No real SBV2 v2 checkpoint has
been inspected yet either (that is an owner step — design doc §12), so there
is nothing yet to validate a real VITS-core port against. Porting
`jaywalnut310/vits`'s text encoder / flow / decoder now, untested against
real weights, would be exactly the kind of unverified-until-a-fixture-lands
risk this project's honesty discipline avoids (see
`tools/parity/utmos_dump_reference.py`'s own module doc: "a reference
generated by a *mirror* of the model validates nothing"). So
`sbv2_dump_reference.py --do-dump` deliberately fails loudly (a clear,
actionable `ImportError`-driven message, never a silent or fabricated
tensor dump) until the modules below actually exist.

## What a follow-up vendoring pass should add here (minimal source only)

Per this task's ambiguity resolution #2 ("Do NOT vendor the whole repo —
pick minimal source") and the design doc §4 crate-layout table's own
module-to-source mapping, only these pieces are actually needed — **not**
`train.py`, `data_utils.py`, `losses.py`, `monotonic_align/`'s Cython
training kernel, or anything else training-only:

| Vendor module (to add) | Upstream source | Feeds parity reference for |
|---|---|---|
| `text_encoder.py` | `jaywalnut310/vits/models.py` `TextEncoder` | `crates/vokra-models/src/sbv2/text_encoder.rs` (`SbV2TextEncoder`) — `phoneme_embed` / `text_hidden` tensors |
| `coupling.py` | `jaywalnut310/vits/modules.py` `ResidualCouplingLayer` (+ `modules.py` `WN` it wraps) | the affine-coupling step inside `flow.py` below |
| `flow.py` | `jaywalnut310/vits/models.py` `ResidualCouplingBlock` | `crates/vokra-models/src/sbv2/flow.rs` (`SbV2Flow`) — `z_latent` tensor |
| `decoder.py` | `jaywalnut310/vits/models.py` `Generator` (HiFi-GAN) | `crates/vokra-models/src/sbv2/decoder.rs` — `waveform` tensor (the Rust side already reuses `vokra-ops::hifigan` at ~100%, per design doc §7's "既存資産の流用度" table; the Python reference is still needed here purely to *dump* the intermediate/final tensors for diffing, not because Rust needs new logic) |

Each vendored file must keep its own `# NOT REFERENCED:
github.com/litagin02/Style-Bert-VITS2 (AGPL-3.0)` / `github.com/fishaudio/
Bert-VITS2 (AGPL-3.0)` header comment (matching the convention already used
in `crates/vokra-models/src/sbv2/*.rs` and
`tools/parity/sbv2_prepare_checkpoint.py`), plus a one-line attribution back
to this README and the pinned commit SHA above. The stochastic duration
predictor (`SbV2SDP` / `sdp_sample` tensor) and the DeBERTa bridge
(`bert_bridge_out` / `speaker_embed` / `style_projected`) are **not** VITS
tensors and do not need anything vendored here — see
`tools/parity/sbv2_dump_reference.py`'s own module doc for how those are
covered by HF `transformers` (Apache-2.0) plus this project's own clean-room
code instead.

## NOT REFERENCED (clean-room, repeated for this directory)

- `github.com/litagin02/Style-Bert-VITS2` (AGPL-3.0) and all forks
- `github.com/fishaudio/Bert-VITS2` (AGPL-3.0) and all forks
- Any community fork/derivative of either of the above

Only `github.com/jaywalnut310/vits` (MIT, this directory) is in scope here.
